root_cause: The LSTM layer in this model uses a dropout rate (dropouts=(0.1, 0.3)), which makes the TensorFlow reference computation stochastic across runs unless a fixed random seed is pinned. OpenVINO's CPU inference path for this LSTM configuration produces results that are numerically close to, but not bit-identical with, the TensorFlow reference (differences up to ~0.28 in one element), so the test's comparison tolerance is occasionally exceeded. This signature has recurred 6 times since 2026-08-27 across unrelated PRs with no shared code change, confirming it is an inherent test flakiness issue in the layer test rather than a regression introduced by PR #39341 (whose changes are confined to src/plugins/hetero/ and do not touch the TensorFlow frontend, LSTM op implementation, or CPU plugin RNN kernels).
reproduction_steps: cd src/frontends/tensorflow/tests/ (or wherever test_tf2_keras_lstm.py is installed) and run: pytest install/tests/layer_tests/tensorflow2_keras_tests/test_tf2_keras_lstm.py::TestKerasLSTM::test_keras_lstm_flags_float32 -k flags_float32 --ie_device=CPU (may require several repeated runs to reproduce due to dropout-induced randomness).
recommended_actions: Pin the TensorFlow dropout RNG seed in the test fixture so framework_res is deterministic across runs, or loosen the comparison tolerance (rtol/atol) specifically for LSTM cases that include dropout.
Consider marking this specific parametrization as xfail/flaky-retry (e.g., via pytest-rerunfailures) until the tolerance is fixed, since it has recurred 6 times without a code-level fix.
Submit the already-verified `rerun_search_string` candidate for human review via propose_rerun_pattern so the workflow rerunner can automatically retry this known-flaky test.
prevention_strategies: Avoid relying on dropout layers in deterministic layer-test comparisons without fixing all RNG seeds (TF's dropout seed as well as any numpy/OpenVINO random state). Where dropout is intentionally exercised, either compare statistical properties (e.g., mean/variance) instead of exact values, or set a generous, documented tolerance for that specific test case.
historical_context: Pattern a284d27dfee44614 has now been observed 6 times since first appearing 2026-08-27, most recently on PRs #39286, #39121, #38168, #37654, #37611, and now #39341.
